description:
We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic Chief Operating Officer (COO) to join a premier organization in Lakewood, NJ. This pivotal leadership role is responsible for overseeing the company's day-to-day operations, ensuring efficiency, productivity, and the achievement of business objectives. The COO will play a critical role in driving operational excellence and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate will be a visionary leader with a proven track record of success in managing complex operations and implementing strategic initiatives. This is an exceptional opportunity to contribute to the growth and success of a dynamic team, shaping the future direction of the organization through effective operational management and strategic planning.
requirements: Minimum of 7-10 years of progressive experience in a senior leadership or operations management role.
Demonstrated expertise in strategic planning, operational efficiency, and business development.
Strong financial acumen and experience with budget management.
Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
